# firstboot_load_balancers (Data Source)

Selects load balancers by tag or by project.

Both filters are applied by the API before paging, so this narrows the whole organization rather than one page. With neither, it answers with every load balancer.

`ids` and `names` are in the same order, so `element(names, index(ids, x))` resolves one from the other.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Match load balancers in this project, or the literal `none` for the ones in no project at all. Those are different questions and a UUID can only ask the first.
- `tags` (Set of String) Match load balancers carrying EVERY tag listed. Two tags mean both, not either: the API's filter is a containment test.

### Read-Only

- `ids` (List of String) The matching ids, oldest first. Hand these to anything that takes a list of load balancers.
- `names` (List of String) The matching names, in the same order as `ids`.
